sections.title: Interface Status and Errors
sections.content: To check interface status on Cisco IOS, use the command 'show ip interface brief'. If an interface shows 'down/down', check the physical cable. If it shows 'up/down', there may be a Layer 2 mismatch or encapsulation issue. Use 'show interfaces' to check for CRC errors or input drops which indicate bad cabling or duplex mismatches.

sections.title: Routing Table Diagnostics
sections.content: Verify OSPF neighbor adjacencies using 'show ip ospf neighbor'. If a neighbor is stuck in EXSTART/EXCHANGE, check for MTU mismatches on both sides of the link. To view the active routing table, use 'show ip route'. A missing route often indicates a network statement is missing in the router configuration.

sections.title: BGP Session Troubleshooting
sections.content: In Junos, verify BGP peering status with 'show bgp summary'. If a peer is in Active or Connect state, check IP reachability and TCP port 179 accessibility. Use 'show route protocol bgp' to view prefixes learned via BGP. To force a soft reset, use 'clear bgp neighbor [ip] soft'.

sections.title: Commit Check and Rollback
sections.content: Always run 'commit check' before applying Junos configurations to validate syntax. If a commit causes issues, you can instantly revert to the previous state using 'rollback 1' followed by 'commit'. To view recent configuration changes, use 'show system commit'.

sections.title: Access Point Registration
sections.content: If an Aruba AP fails to join the Mobility Controller, check the AP database using 'show ap database'. If the status is 'Down', verify DHCP is providing Option 43 with the controller's IP. Also ensure the AP is approved in the control plane if CPsec (Control Plane Security) is enabled.

sections.title: Client Connectivity Issues
sections.content: To troubleshoot a specific client on Aruba, use 'show ap client trail-info [mac-address]'. This displays the state machine progression. If a client is stuck in 'PTK' state, it indicates a WPA2 passphrase mismatch. High retry rates in 'show ap debug radio-stats' suggest RF interference.
